packages.label: כָּבוֹד וְהֶאָרָתוֹ
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of divine Kavod (Glory): light, illumination, the Hanukkah candle that manifests it, the act of returning it to its root, and the mechanism (bringing people to teshuvah / Torah soul-sparking) by which that elevation is achieved. The Rebbe explicitly equates אור = כבוד (Yechezkel 43:2), יום = אור (light = day), הדלקת הנר = הארת הכבוד, and מכבד יראי השם = החזרת הכבוד לשרשו. Bringing people to teshuvah is equated with 'אם תוציא יקר מזולל' which IS the definition of Kavod's elevation. Soul-sparking through Torah recitation is equated with זיווג — the reproductive mechanism that creates the illuminated souls needed for Kavod's rise.
nodes: נתעוררים הנשמות על ידי אותיות התורה שהוציא מפיו ומתנוצצים זה לזה
merge_notes: Raw components B {יום, אור, כבוד, שלום בית} and E {הדלקת הנר, הארת הכבוד} merged: הארת הכבוד shares essential nature with כבוד (both are expressions of Kavod's luminosity).
Component F {מכבד יראי השם, החזרת הכבוד לשרשו} merged: honoring G-d-fearers IS defined as returning Kavod to its root — same bechina.
Component C {להחזיר בני אדם בתשובה, אם תוציא יקר מזולל} merged: bringing to teshuvah is explicitly equated with 'extracting the precious from the vile' which is how Kavod rises — same bechina.
Component G {נתעוררים הנשמות, זווג} merged: the sparking of souls through Torah = zivug is the mechanism of drawing souls into holiness — same kavod-elevation domain.

packages.label: יִרְאָה
packages.label_en: Fear of God — Root of Glory
packages.reason: These three nodes share the essential nature of Yirah (awe/fear of God). The Rebbe equates: כסא = יראה (the throne-word alludes to what is hidden in the heart — fear of God, 'דבר המסור ללב'); גבורה = יראה ('וֶאֱלֹקִים עָשָׂה שֶׁיִּירְאוּ מִלְּפָנָיו' are the thunders, and 'רַעַם גְּבוּרוֹתָיו'). Yirah is the שרש (root) to which Kavod must be returned — it is a distinct domain from Kavod itself, representing the inner, hidden quality that anchors everything.
merge_notes: No merges needed — this is a coherent 3-node component already. Kept separate from Package 1 because Yirah is the root/שרש to which Kavod returns — a structurally distinct level in the teaching's architecture.

packages.label: שָׁלוֹם — גּוּף וּנְשָׁמָה
packages.reason: These nodes all share the essential nature of Shalom (peace/wholeness), expressed through the lens of body-soul alignment and universal peace. The Rebbe equates: ארץ = גוף (earth = body), עשיה = גוף (action-world = body), מעשיך = עשיה (Psalm 145 'your deeds' = physical world), רקיע = נשמה (firmament = soul), חסידיך = נפש (Psalm 145 'thy pious' = the soul-aspect), דנשקי ארעא ורקיעא = שלום בעצמיו (earth and sky kissing = inner peace of body-soul alignment), and שתכלה רגל מן השוק = שלום (cessation of the strife-walkers = Peace). All these are different expressions of the same underlying reality: harmony/completeness/peace.
merge_notes: Raw components D {ארץ, גוף, עשיה, מעשיך} (4 nodes), K {רקיע, נשמה} (2 nodes), J {חסידיך, נפש} (2 nodes), O {דנשקי ארעא ורקיעא, שלום בעצמיו} (2 nodes), and N {שתכלה רגל מן השוק, שלום} (2 nodes) all merged here.

D merges as body-metaphors (גוף, ארץ, עשיה = physical plane); K and J as soul-metaphors (נשמה, רקיע, נפש, חסידיך = spiritual plane); O directly equates earth-sky conjunction with inner peace; N equates cessation of strife-walkers with shalom — all expressing the same peace/wholeness domain.
Note: מעשיך connects to עשיה which connects to גוף; this internal bechina chain was already present in raw Component D before the merge.

packages.label: תְּפִלָּה
packages.reason: These nodes share the essential nature of Tefillah (prayer / divine service). The Rebbe equates: 'טוב ה' לכל' (the verse expressing complete faith in God's goodness) = תפלה (because the one who believes God is good to all directs all his effort toward God — prayer — rather than worldly stratagems); שמירת המועד = עבודה תמה (observing festivals is equated with complete/pure divine service, and 'there is no service except prayer' — אין עבודה אלא תפלה). These all express the same essence: perfect orientation of the person toward God in prayer.
merge_notes: Raw component P {"טוב ה לכל", תפלה} and component M {שמירת המועד, עבודה תמה} merged: both pairs are about the same essential nature — perfect, wholehearted divine service as prayer. The Rebbe explicitly links: עבודה תמה = תפלה (via the Talmudic ruling אין עבודה אלא תפלה); belief in 'Hashem is good to all' IS prayer (directing all effort toward God rather than human stratagems).

packages.label: מַחֲלֹקֶת וּלְשׁוֹן הָרָע
packages.reason: These nodes share the essential nature of Machlokes (strife, discord) and its manifestations. The Rebbe equates: רגל = 'נרגן מפריד אלוף' (the 'walker/foot' of evil speech = the slanderer who separates alliances); רגל = בעלי לשון הרע ומחלקת (the foot = masters of evil speech and strife); כל החולאת = מחלקת (all illnesses = strife — because disease is the elements within the body warring against each other, no shalom within); כנעני = סוחר (the Canaanite = the merchant, because commerce itself arises from the absence of peace between buyers and sellers, i.e., machlokes of wills). This cluster is the evil mirror of the good Package 3 (Shalom): where Shalom is the alignment of opposites, Machlokes is their warfare.
merge_notes: Raw components A {רגל, נרגן מפריד אלוף, בעלי לשון הרע ומחלקת} (3 nodes), I {כל החולאת, מחלקת} (2 nodes), and L {כנעני, סוחר} (2 nodes) merged.

A and I share essential nature: both are expressions of discord/strife — slander creates social machlokes, illness is physical machlokes (elements at war). The Rebbe states explicitly: כל חולאת = בחינת מחלקת.

L merged: כנעני = סוחר is the economic manifestation of machlokes (commerce exists because people's wills are in conflict). The Rebbe cites Bereishit 13:7 — 'ויהי ריב... והכנעני אז בארץ' — strife causes merchants to exist. Same essential nature as discord.
